column1: # THE DAMAGE SHAPES a stored Elixir ebin entry is held against (F-217;
# The rig stores the ebin of a stand-in compile (A.beam "alpha\n", B.beam
# "beta\n"), applies one row's damage to the stored entry, and runs again:
# a row with expect "hit" must be handed back with no compile; every other
# row must be DISCARDED (its reason named), compiled, and the ebin the job
# gets must be the compile's own bytes. A row's file is relative to the entry.
